[[File:Ersham_Ridge_2.jpg|thumb|250px|A spacer in the Ersham Ridge.]]
The '''Ersham Ridge''' was a mountainous jungle region on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. It was separated from the [[Wayward Jungle]] and the [[Taurin Delta]] by the [[Unnh River]]. The [[Great Temple/Legends|Great Massassi Temple]] and the [[Labor Outpost]] were located in this region.<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Ersham Ridge was one of many designated planetary regions in the [[Wikipedia:MMORPG|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''.<ref name="SWG" />
